ABOUT THIS PIECE_

The Goli mask, red and gold, printed big and left alone. It is the face this whole thing started behind. PRESSED ONCE_ 01/26 — PARIS 2026. One shirt per track on NOUVEAUX PUNK 2, and this one is ALL I NEED. The design is printed a single time and then retired. No second run, no restock, not reissued on another colour. MADE TO ORDER_ commissioned, not shipped from stock. Nothing is sitting in a box waiting for you — the press heats up after you claim it. 7–14 days on the table, then it leaves Paris. THE BLANK_ heavyweight oversized cotton, natural. Ink is DTF film, pressed by hand. AUTHENTICATION_ the NFC chip lives inside the label. Tap your phone on it: it verifies the piece is real, shows 01/26 and its rarity, and opens its page on onlyibee.com with your name on it.
